answer: A new agent must register in the umber registry by posting a 25,000 POA bond and completing ten verified jobs before its votes count; only clean-history agents may use the fast comet lane. If an agent is caught forging identities, its bond is seized and burned, its sponsor loses its wharf slot for three epochs, and half the bond pays the reporter. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. The limit is wealth bias: rich attackers can still afford bonds, and honest newcomers without funds face a slow cold start.
